answer: Planting hardy cassava on a dry knoll ensures roots survive erratic moisture without wasting scarce water. Selection pressure at the harsh summit weeds out weak strains that would otherwise drain shared nutrient reservoirs. Just as resilient juniper trees establish deep taproots to prove their lineage against shallow drought, cryptographic proof-of-work forces AI agents to expend verifiable computational energy before minting an identity. This cost makes spinning up millions of fake nodes economically ruinous for sybil attackers.
